scripts.dev:pages: cd pages && wrangler pages dev dist --port 5173
scripts.deploy:pages: cd pages && npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist
scripts.db:migrate: cd workers && wrangler d1 migrations apply quickprint-db
scripts.db:migrate:local: cd workers && wrangler d1 migrations apply quickprint-db --local
scripts.db:seed: cd workers && wrangler d1 execute quickprint-db --file=../migrations/seed.sql
